answer_1.quote: We select "emotion" as a representative concept to evaluate each method's ability to inject and preserve abstract semantic content. ... The outputs are generated sentences after concept editing.

answer_2.quote: We employed GPT-4 to assess the emotional intensity of the generated sentences. Specifically, GPT-4 was used to score the emotional intensity of the generation before and after concept editing.

answer_4.quote: We manually assessed the results, which were found to be comparable to those of GPT-4. ... We have re-sampled 10 sets of experimental results, with 40% of the samples (80 data points) in each result manually verified.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters manually verified the emotional intensity scores and consistency with GPT-4 evaluations.
